newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: AUSTRALIAN STOCKS SEEN FIRMER AS U.S. SURGES.
newsitem.headline: AUSTRALIAN STOCKS SEEN FIRMER AS U.S. SURGES.

text.p: *Stocks seen firmer early with U.S. strength, solid investor interest. "I think it will be firmer at least early on after Wall Street and the reports of money about," said one broker.
*Wall Street snapped back from four sessions of doldrums to close at record highs as long term interest rates dipped.
*ADRs: News Corp 18-1/8 (steady), BHP 26-7/16 (+4/16), WMC 22-11/16 (-3/16), National Australia Bank 72-1/2 (+7/8)
*Gold price was lower. On LME, zinc and aluminium surged on speculative buying and short-covering. Nickel fell through support, while copper edged just higher.
